newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani money market rates remain high.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani money market rates remain high.

text.p: Pakistani money market rates remained high on borrowing pressure on Tuesday with banks tapping the central bank repo facility, dealers said.
"There was no respite in overnight rates as trading continued to be conducted at the 17 percent level," a dealer at KASB & Co said.

"The market was unable to square itself and the State Bank of Pakistan repo window had to be tapped," he said. The rates were likely to remain high on Wednesday amid the weekly open market operation the central bank.
